messages:
maria: Hi team — drafting an SI onboarding + certification playbook. Need quick feedback on required artifacts before we share with partner SIs.
lee: Nice. Please include marketplace listing requirements and what metadata we expect for certified SIs.
jamal: SE ask: provide a pre-provisioned dev tenant, sample webhook->Redwood repo, and a deterministic smoke test so demos are reliable.
sophia: Cert levels proposal: Integrator, Advanced Integrator, Partner Engineer. Each requires labs + deployment review. Badge + co-brand kit for marketing.
anita: DevEx will build modular labs in LMS: quickstart, embeddings, inference ops. Prefer self-serve with a proctored capstone for higher tiers. Example smoke test: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-1","input":"ping"}'` expect non-empty output.
lee: For hardware partners (NVIDIA/Lambda/CoreWeave) we need a validation checklist (driver/CUDA versions, nv_peer_mem, NIC MTU) and a partner lab image. Ask partners for lab credits for workshops.
marketplace-bot: Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/partner/marketplace-staging — staging accepts custom metadata fields.
maria: Access ops question: who provisions dev tenants and service accounts? We need a short playbook for scopes + KMS sign-off for private deployments.
jamal: Ops should own provisioning. I'll draft a service-account template and KMS access steps for security review.
sophia: Rubric idea: 50% labs, 30% deployment review (72h in staging), 20% exam (30m scenario-based). Provide verify_cert URL in marketplace listing.
anita: Request from infra: minimal model pack (configs + quant profiles) and two fixed prompt templates so labs are repeatable. I can wire badge issuance via API.
lee: Internal escalation path for hardware blockers: single-threaded contact: jamal -> infra-support -> partner-eng.
maria: Timeline: share draft with SI leads by Wed (first_message_ts + 3d), run kickoff workshop in 3 weeks, run pilot cohort week 6. I'll consolidate and post updated playbook by EOD Friday. React :thumbsup: if you agree or call out conflicts.
